changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_poems_search_vec ON poems
CREATE TRIGGER trg_poems_search_vec BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF name, content, author_id, transliteration, translation, meaning ON poems FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION poems_search_vec_trg()

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authors_refresh_poems_search() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE poems SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(NEW.name, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(content, ''))), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(transliteration, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(translation, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(meaning, ''))), 'D') WHERE author_id = NEW.id; RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

changeSet.sql: UPDATE poems p SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(a.name, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.content, ''))), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.transliteration, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.translation, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.meaning, ''))), 'D') FROM authors a WHERE a.id = p.author_id

UPDATE poems SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(content, ''))), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(transliteration, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(translation, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(meaning, ''))), 'D') WHERE author_id IS NULL
